payload.title: feat/record 2b03fa3c4d3e: the record on refs/hyp/record, refusing to read past a record git cannot read
payload.body: Commit 2b03fa3c4d3e on feat/record over 3a3220f33263 (h-record-6). Every git call takes paths literally, so hyp import untracks an uncited file named like a glob and leaves the cited file it matches tracked (limit R-EK3R0H#1). In a record repository with no git on PATH, or a .git git cannot open, hyp status, hyp show and a write exit 3 and write nothing; with no record ref on disk they use the work-tree store (limit R-EK3R0H#2). hyp show FILE@SHA prints only bytes with that sha256, else exits 1. It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The successor of h-record-6 that closes its limits.
h-record-7 is h-record-6 with a fix for each of its limits.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: feat/record f05165acc154: the record on refs/hyp/record, reading a corrupt reftable as unknown
payload.body: Commit f05165acc154 on feat/record over b8521fac4e6d (h-record-9). An out-of-Goal fix from the review of E-4YM17J: the reftable reader checks each varint length against its block, and a panic while reading a table counts as a stack hyp cannot read, so with no git a corrupt table gives exit 3, not a panic and exit 2. TestAddGoalRefusesATruncatedHash names its refused Goal by a title no random id contains, so it no longer flakes. It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

payload.summary: Stopped: 5 Results recorded under claude-g181-4 (R-J906AP, R-F2YZJJ, R-V2CMZQ, R-29MR4B, R-WX9YBH). R-V2CMZQ supports h-record-9 (b8521fac4e6d); h-record-10b (32d707c23b7c) and h-record-11 (6e298332bcb4) are contradicted; limits R-WX9YBH#1-#3 (colon in a store folder name, #8; staged unnamed evidence file at untrack, #6; dot-import, execve and unix.Exec program starts, #10) are owed on a successor. H-EGXQHF abandoned: its commit was rewritten before its gate. Candidates not reviewed: none. Waiting for the owner: R-V2CMZQ#r1. Review findings with no run: snapshot prune by mtime may race a reader (E-SF8QZJ); NamesOf keeps no base commit of a Result's run subjects (E-SF8QZJ); a store folder inside a bundle is not joined by id at sync (E-BTM3WF, #5); sync pushes without a lease (E-BTM3WF). Process: the first gate run of E-4YM17J shared a checkout with its reviewer and was run again; the briefs of E-0CFRCJ and E-4YM17J named 2b03fa3c4d3e as the checkout once, and each reviewer tested its own commit; from E-SF8QZJ the brief adds that the reviewer uses a folder of its own.
